{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sovereign Forge''' was a planned mining station and [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] designed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The plans for the station were stolen by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Varek Tarn]], but the Empire recovered them when Tarn [[Battle in the Cha Raaba system|attempted]] to sell them in the [[Cha Raaba system]].<ref name="TOR:CRA">{{TORcite|type=space|Cha Raaba Assault}}</ref>
